lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of high-luminance circular maxima arranged in approximately 5-7 visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with higher density clusters located on the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density concentration of small-diameter high-luminance clusters is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger-diameter blobs on the primary flank.
